schema_name: SHF Career Pathway Acceptance Record Schema v1
description: Defines the fields every SHF Career Pathway Acceptance Record must carry. This is a cross-domain INDEX/PROJECTION document, not a new canonical authority. Every *_ref/*_id field below references an existing canonical domain's own identifier; it never restates or duplicates that domain's content.
canonical_owner_notice: No backend table exists for this schema in Phase 1 of CPAS-1. Records are authored as JSON documents under docs/career/records/. If a future phase promotes this to a live, queryable system, the recommended smallest-safe owner is a new table inside the existing `careers` domain (see the Standard's Canonical Domain Boundaries section) — not a new top-level domain.

pathway_id.description: Stable slug id for this pathway, e.g. 'data-center-ai-infrastructure'.

version.description: Version of this record, independent of the Standard's own version.

properties.career_ref: careers domain career_id, or null if not yet a canonical Career record
properties.title: string
properties.status: enum: EXISTING CANONICAL | NEEDS SEPARATE CAREER PHASE

target_learners.description: Grade band(s) / audience this pathway serves.

age_requirements.description: Only populated where a real requirement exists; null otherwise.

curriculum_refs.description: curriculum_id values as used in career_curriculum_requirements.

lesson_refs.description: May be summarized as a count + directory reference rather than enumerated when large.

learning_arcade_links.description: Empty array means confirmed none, not unexamined.

knowledge_assessment.description: How knowledge is assessed and whether it is canonically evidenced.

portfolio_relationships.description: Must describe the ACTUAL current code path, not an aspirational one.

properties.name: string
properties.status: enum: NOT ISSUED / PLANNED | ALIGNED | ISSUED

employer_validators.description: Must be real, named, evidenced reviewers only — never invented.

education_training_partners.description: Category references are not commitments and must be labeled as such.

source_evidence_refs.description: File/migration/test paths that back this record's status classification.
